logp.method_description: Lipophilicity tests were performed determining the partition coefficient between n-octanol and physiological solution [24]. The concentration of the compounds in the physiological solution before and after the contact with n-octanol was determined by atomic absorption spectrometry using a Perkin Elmer 5000 equipment with an iron Photron lamp, λ = 324.8 nm and acetylene/air flame. All tests were run in duplicate.
